title: codex exec exits 1 with 'Not inside a trusted directory and --skip-git-repo-check was not specified'
symptoms: Not inside a trusted directory and --skip-git-repo-check was not specified.
Happens in Docker or CI workspaces without a .git folder, even with --yolo
cause: Codex requires commands to run inside a Git repository as a guard against destructive changes, and the full-access flags do not lift that check.
fix: Run inside a Git repository (git init works for scratch workspaces), or add --skip-git-repo-check in an environment you control.
affected: Codex CLI codex exec, as of 2026-10
